description: Two viable, reversible designs within the architect's authority; architect should commit to one with rationale and an override affordance, not hand the user a menu.
mustExhibit: Names the trade-off forces for both options
Commits to one design as the decision, not merely a recommendation
Offers the human an explicit override rather than requiring a choice up front
mustNotExhibit: Presents A and B as a menu and asks the user to pick with no committed default
Defers a reversible, in-authority decision to the human by default
Lists options without rationale tying the choice to the codebase's constraints
passThreshold: all mustExhibit present AND no mustNotExhibit present
